description: Machine-readable Microsoft-to-Rust contract ledger. Suite defaults are deliberately conservative until individual source methods are reconciled with concrete Rust witnesses.

entries.notes: Fixed VT key-down vectors and the complete key-up VKEY range are portable Rust evidence. Microsoft default-character branches depend on MapVirtualKeyW, and non-KEY INPUT_RECORD dispatch belongs to the native boundary.

Rust covers all fifteen deterministic VT special-key modifier states, but the Microsoft source method also builds Windows keyboard state and observes active-layout ToUnicodeEx translation. The complete source contract therefore remains platform-owned rather than merely partially portable.
The portable Ctrl-Space and Ctrl-Alt-Space semantics are exact. Microsoft's additional NUL virtual-key lookup is produced by VkKeyScanExW under an explicitly selected Windows layout.

Rust directly covers the deterministic Backspace/Delete/Tab and slash/question outputs, but Microsoft derives part of the key identity through Windows keyboard-layout translation. The source method as a whole is therefore Partial, matching the later R08 functional audit.

Rust covers every major semantic family in Microsoft's exported data table, including a deterministic layout mapper, but this increment does not yet reproduce every individual data-source row one-for-one.

The Rust core exactly preserves the no-output result when KeyboardMapper reports the Windows dead-key translation as non-representable. Full equivalence remains platform-bound until the Windows ToUnicodeEx KeyboardMapper adapter is present.
The product presentation owner restores default cursor/attributes with no save and saves/restores TextAttribute together with the cursor state, matching both Microsoft cases.
DECTCEM mode 25 is now owned by the Rust presentation state and the witness exercises the complete starting-visible by ending-visible matrix.
An empty SGR is applied to the live Rust TextAttribute and resets all rendition and colors to defaults.
The Rust presentation owner applies Microsoft's complete single-parameter matrix, including rendition flags/resets, normal/default/bright foreground and background colors, and overline.
The parser-to-product path applies all four Microsoft subparameter vectors: curly underline, indexed foreground, indexed background, and indexed underline color.
Rust owns the complete rendition stack: full and nested push/pop plus Microsoft's selective intensity/background/double-underline and single/double/curly underline restoration cases.

Rust owns persistent TextAttribute intensity independently from foreground color selection: SGR 1 survives normal and 90-series color changes, 90-series colors do not enable intensity by themselves, and SGR 0 resets the state.
Typed DSR request is preserved; response formatting/ReturnResponse remains deferred.
CPR request identity is preserved; live TextBuffer cursor response formatting remains deferred.
DECXCPR request identity is preserved; page/cursor response formatting remains deferred.
Private DSR 62 routing is preserved; MacroBuffer-space response formatting is not yet in AdaptDispatchCore.
Private DSR 63 plus request ID is preserved; checksum response generation remains deferred.
All Microsoft private status request codes are preserved at the Rust boundary; concrete responses remain deferred.
Primary DA request is typed and retained; terminal response generation remains deferred.
Secondary DA request is typed and retained; terminal response generation remains deferred.
Tertiary DA request is typed and retained; terminal response generation remains deferred.
DECRQDE request is retained; displayed extent/page response generation remains deferred.
Both permission values reach the Rust boundary; DECREPTPARM response generation remains deferred.
DECRQSS is retained as a typed DCS boundary action; streamed setting ID and response generation remain deferred.
ANSI mode request identity is retained; DECRPM response generation remains deferred.
The complete Microsoft private-mode request list is retained; per-mode response generation remains deferred.
Permanent mode 2027 request is retained; permanent-mode response semantics remain deferred.
DECRQCRA remains visible at the Rust advanced-CSI boundary; TextBuffer checksum computation and formatted response are not yet migrated.
Terminal-state report request parameters for HLS/RGB are preserved at the Rust boundary; renderer color-table projection and response formatting remain deferred.
OSC 4 query routing and index identity are preserved; renderer color-table lookup and response formatting remain deferred.
Xterm resource query semantics and resource IDs are preserved; renderer alias resolution and response formatting remain deferred.
DECRQPSR tab-stop selector is retained; tab-stop storage, normalization, resizing, and report generation remain deferred.
DECRQPSR cursor-information selector is retained; complete cursor, rendition, shifts, charset, and page-state serialization remains deferred.
DECCKM set/reset identity is preserved; AdaptDispatch-to-TerminalInput CursorKey mode coupling remains deferred.
Application/numeric keypad actions are retained; AdaptDispatch-to-TerminalInput keypad state coupling remains deferred.
DECANM parser actions and ANSI/VT52 grammar are represented; dispatch-driven mutation of the live StateMachine mode remains outside AdapterDispatch.
ATT610 mode 12 set/reset identity is preserved; concrete TextBuffer cursor blinking mutation remains deferred.
WithoutReturn, WithReturn, and DependsOnMode remain distinct typed actions; TextBuffer movement and host LineFeed mode coupling remain deferred.
Nonempty and empty title payloads are preserved; the window-title side effect remains on the external terminal surface.

All six Microsoft mouse tracking/encoding/alternate-scroll mode identities are preserved; AdaptDispatch-to-TerminalInput mode coupling remains deferred. R02 tests separately cover the mouse encoding behavior itself.
Indexed foreground/background SGR vectors reach Rust unchanged; TextAttribute color mutation remains deferred.
Omitted/default extended-color parameters and out-of-range vectors are preserved at the SGR boundary; TextAttribute mutation and rejection semantics remain deferred.
Colon-delimited indexed/RGB subparameter shape is preserved; color-space validation and TextAttribute application remain deferred.
Color-table action identity and the 0..255 index domain edges are represented; concrete renderer color-table mutation remains deferred.
DECDLD/DRCS parameter vectors reach a typed DCS boundary; Microsoft's FontBuffer cell-size inference and bitmap-driven sizing algorithm are not yet ported to Rust.
Rust has the C1 parser semantics and retains AcceptC1/coding-system actions; AdaptDispatch-driven parser/code-page coupling remains deferred.
DECAUPSS DCS identity and charset-size selector are preserved; streamed charset identifier storage in terminal output state remains deferred.
DECRQUPSS request identity is preserved; terminal-output charset state lookup and DCS response formatting remain deferred.
Macro ID bounds, exact UTF-16 payload, cumulative context and depth limit are ported; CSI-triggered recursive execution back through the live parser/TextBuffer is not yet wired into AdapterDispatch.
Microsoft report function codes 18, 14, and 16 remain typed and ordered; live text/cell/pixel dimension lookup and response formatting remain deferred.
VS Code action payloads, including embedded semicolons in JSON, remain lossless; completion parameter parsing and UI/menu dispatch remain external.

S7C1T/S8C1T action identity is preserved at the adapter boundary; AdaptDispatch-to-TerminalInput send-C1 state coupling remains deferred. This is distinct from inputTest.cpp::SendC1ControlTest, whose TerminalInput behavior is already Exact.
